fitting.objective: Equal separately normalized endpoint and unchanged-token paired residual loss; q=P*R in FP64.
fitting.search: Greedy globally best relaxed split; leafDFS/feature/cut tie order. Exact duplicate right masks use first feature/cut. Cholesky Schur score, direct partition solve for cancellation-dominated denominator; no explicit inverse.
fitting.targetAndSlot0Policy: FP64 R=Y-S from actual finite slot0; relaxed q=P*R. Actual finite response measured against separately formed native YB-YA.
fitting.weighting: Equal history/active-padding endpoints;equal pair/active-padding unchanged learned rows;each measure sums1.
fitting.zeroEnergyPolicy: Use absolute corresponding component; no divide by zero.

limitations: Reused public transfer;novel raw prompt unscored.
Offline teacher/fitting/lexical costs and native evaluation paid.
One greedy relaxed objective/search;not a global or finite optimum.
No attention,MLP,fullencoder,denoiser,VAE or image. No matched speedup or isolated child memory claim.
metricSemantics: Complete endpoints with native-increment-normalized error;endpoint RMS/cosine are not increment alignment. Pair metrics are signed prompt responses.
